immediate_mini_pilot.purpose: debug construct definitions, reviewer independence, forms, labor and preliminary machine-label precision; not publication-level validation

current_families.same_source_warning: The five current retained families occupy only three videos and cannot alone meet source-disjointness.

minimum_coverage_rules: include every eligible ambient or V+S+A family when their total is at most 12; otherwise sample at least 12
include at least 8 machine/validator disagreement families if available
include at least 8 learned/control ranking disagreement families if available
include at least 6 correct-answer/wrong-citation families if available
include at least 8 uncertain-minimality or alternative-support families if available
include every source/domain when feasible, otherwise document uncovered strata
reserve at least 20 percent of the sample for deterministic random low-risk controls

promotion_evidence: at least two independent machine validators or methods

allowed_uses: candidate benchmark inclusion subject to adjudication policy
promotion_evidence: all four independent role forms complete
two validators agree on critical constructs
forbidden_claims: adjudicated gold unless H2 gate passes

promotion_evidence: H1 evidence or complete pre-adjudication role inputs
independent blind sixth-person post-adjudication saturation audit
forbidden_claims: publicly redistributable unless rights/release gate independently passes
representative of unseen domains without sampling evidence

roles.question_claim_author_or_verifier: May author or independently verify wording and claims; cannot serve in any other role for the same family.
roles.blind_alternative_evidence_finder: Searches the full source before seeing the preferred SES, machine tier, machine confidence, machine ranks, validator outcomes or adjudication.
roles.validator_a: Independently assesses all constructs and counterfactuals without validator B decisions.
roles.validator_b: Independently assesses all constructs and counterfactuals without validator A decisions.
roles.adjudicator: Reviews the four completed pre-adjudication role records after independent submission; must be a fifth identity.
roles.blind_post_adjudication_saturation_audit: A sixth identity who starts only after adjudication is frozen; receives only the source, frozen question and source provenance/duration, never the accepted SES ledger, preferred SES, machine ranks, validator decisions or adjudication decisions; logs chronological full-source coverage and every new route.

agreement.nominal: Cohen's kappa for validator A/B categorical critical labels and family outcome; report raw agreement when kappa is unstable
agreement.ordinal: quadratic-weighted kappa for confidence if analyzed
agreement.interval: temporal IoU and boundary absolute error for evidence intervals

statistics.confidence_intervals: Wilson 95% intervals for binomial rates; bootstrap source-clustered intervals only after at least 20 sources; no normal approximation for low N
statistics.low_n: All 8-12 family results carry LOW_N_MINI_PILOT_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; do not use hypothesis tests or generalize model/tier precision.

CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY_MINI_PILOT_GO: 8-12 families and at least 5 source-disjoint videos completed
all six distinct human roles complete, including adjudication and post-adjudication saturation audit
every saturation audit has complete chronological source coverage and finds no new sufficient route
no systematic modality/minimality failure affecting more than 25% of completed families
CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY_REPAIR: at least 40% reach H1 or failures are localized and repairable
no evidence that the central construct is unreviewable
protocol, wording, route closure, or forms require revision before expansion
CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY_NO_GO: fewer than 40% reach H1 after complete review
systematic alternative-support, minimality, necessity, or pair-isolation failures invalidate the construct
rights/privacy/safety constraints make the intended data unusable
expand_after_mini_pilot: then sample 30-50 from a 100-200 provisional-family pool
repeat sampling if a key high-risk stratum has fewer than five completed families

commands.packet: python tools/construct_validity_packet.py --registry REGISTRY.json --sample SAMPLE.json --output-dir PORTABLE_PACKET --media-mode none
